name: Solve quantitative physics problems
description: Users asked to solve quantitative physics problems spanning mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, and optics, often requiring numerical calculations for specific parameters like force, energy, or velocity. In some instances, users requested step-by-step derivations, formula applications, code generation for visualizations, or verification of provided solutions.
